limitations: Instrumented observations, not a controlled elapsed-time comparison; use the matched uninstrumented build report.
Completed background work can differ because of cancellation and trace boundaries; syscall deltas are not normalized per sealed artifact.
Summed syscall and phase times overlap; they are not additional Cargo wall time.
Boundary-incomplete calls are excluded from interval timing; exact duplicates are counted once and exposed explicitly.
No FUSE request tracepoints on this kernel. Stack samples are user-space only; /proc counters additionally measure total daemon kernel CPU.
Daemon CPU totals include Cargo plus the post-build idle observation, excluding profiler shutdown and draining unmount.
